content:
Got a new iPhone 18 Pro today. Went for a 512 GB in Glacier, which looks nice. I don’t have a case for it yet. I wish I trusted myself enough to go caseless, but I don’t. They really do feel so much better without a case.

I traded in my iPhone 16 Pro to Apple and got $510 for it, which seemed like a decent price. I can’t be bothered with anything more complicated. I was almost certain I was going to pre-order the Duo, but I can’t imagine compromising on the cameras, which are way more important than having a foldable phone. And it’s fucking expensive, even with the wife’s employee discount.
